item.title: Missing Chesterfield man found safe, police say
item.description: A missing 56-year-old Chesterfield County man who police say has a "cognitive impairment" may be in danger.

item.title: Burn barrel sparks two-to-three-acre brush fire in Prince George County, officials say
item.description: A burn barrel reportedly sparked a two-to-three-acre brush fire in Prince George County Monday evening.

item.title: 'Renaissance Faire on Wheels' to be held by River City Roller Derby at Henrico's Roller Dome
item.description: Looking to get festive and active this week? The River City Roller Derby will host "Renaissance Faire on Wheels" at the Roller Dome in Henrico County Thursday evening.

item.title: 41st Lebanese Food Festival to return to Henrico in September
item.description: The 41st Lebanese Food Festival will be returning to the Richmond area in September, featuring a variety of dishes and treats as well as live music and entertainment.

item.title: Comedian Steph Tolev to perform at the Richmond Funny Bone
item.description: Comedian Steph Tolev will be making a stop at the Richmond Funny Bone on Friday and Saturday.

item.title: Three injured after six-vehicle crash on Chippenham Parkway
item.description: Three people were injured after a six-vehicle crash on Chippenham Parkway on Tuesday morning.

item.title: Petersburg mother, 11-year-old brother charged after 6-year-old girl shot, killed
item.description: A Petersburg mother and her 11-year-old son are facing charges after police say the boy shot his 6-year-old sister, killing her.

item.title: Spanberger to reenter Virginia in multi-state, bipartisan voter registration group
item.description: Gov. Abigail Spanberger (D) signed an executive order on Tuesday to reenter a bipartisan, multi-state group that helps maintain voter rolls -- a move she says will strengthen and protect election integrity in Virginia.

item.title: 'He would force me': Day one of trial against former Powhatan business owner accused of 18 child sex crimes
item.description: The first day of a two-day trial against the former owner of Fast Feet Sports Academy in Powhatan County is complete. Joseph Parker is facing 18 counts of child sex crimes after six girls between the ages of nine and 12 accused him of inappropriately touching them.

item.title: 'Unknown substance' mailed to Richmond City Justice Center
item.description: A package containing an "unknown substance" was mailed to Richmond's city jail on Tuesday, causing employees to be quarantined.

item.title: Outdoor fire spreads to shed in Louisa, smoke seen by firefighters prompts response
item.description: After an outdoor fire spread to a shed in Louisa County on Tuesday, and smoke from the blaze was seen by firefighters, crews responded and were able to get the fire under control.

item.title: Spanberger urges 'yes' vote on controversial redistricting proposal in new campaign ad
item.description: After voting "yes" herself a week prior, Gov. Abigail Spanberger (D) is urging Virginians to support the controversial mid-decade redistricting referendum in a brand-new advertisement launched Wednesday.

item.title: Richmond-area postal worker sentenced to four years for $1.5 million mail theft, fraud scheme
item.description: A Richmond-area U.S. Postal Service (USPS) employee was sentenced to four years in prison on Wednesday after prosecutors say he stole more than $1.5 million in checks in a bank fraud scheme.

item.title: Man fighting for life after being hit by train in Richmond
item.description: A man is fighting for his life after police say he was hit by a train in Richmond on Wednesday morning.

item.title: Spanberger creates chief energy officer position, appoints Charlottesville attorney
item.description: RICHMOND, Va. (WRIC) -- Gov. Abigail Spanberger (D) has created a new cabinet-level position focused on lowering energy costs -- and she has selected a Charlottesville attorney to fill the role.
